title: Marguerite and the Static
author: Oscar Amberdale
blurb: Bram Amberdale, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
